title: Otori Emu — After A Dream〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: The Song of a Canary in Crisis

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I ended up coming even though we don't have practice today...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Our last show yesterday was so amazing...
All the guests had such wonderhoy smiles on their faces too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, Sakurako, Nene, everyone...
They sparkled and shined so much.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Naturally, this show revolved around Rio and myself. After all, we are the main characters.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
However...
Your singing and acting gave us a massive boost.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Yes.
The scene where Rio hesitates to plunge his dagger into the phoenix...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: We were clearly one with the audience.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa and Nene were both so amazing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Performing in different places with other people would be a good way to learn more about specialized things.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (In different places... So, not the Wonder Stage...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: When the time comes for them to say that they wish to leave the Wonder Stage, will you try to follow in their footsteps?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because my dream's to protect Grandpa's amusement park and keep it the way it is.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And make a place where everyone smiles!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(What I told Rui wasn't a lie...
Because that dream... Will never ever change.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Nene and Tsukasa both wanna become better at singing and acting...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Because their dream's to perform all around the world.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I feel a little sad about that, but it's okay...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: When the time comes for them to say that they wish to leave the Wonder Stage, will you try to follow in their footsteps?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Oh, was it because I seemed sad? Maybe he was just worried...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll need to thank him when we practice next♪
Alright, why don't we do some exercises that'll help increase our stamina?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But why? We don't have practice today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We could be asking you the same thing.
I suspect you're still thrilled about what happened yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean you guys also...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. We all ran into each other just now and began talking about practicing for a bit since we're here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um... Thanks for what you said yesterday☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yesterday? Did I do something that merits being thanked?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Don't worry about that. I just wanted to thank you is all♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Anyway, let's make this a really good practice!
